description: Verdict URL-rule overlay template. The public tree ships EMPTY (asset separation 2026-10-25): platform login fronts and wall needles are operator business data. Load a private table via DITING_VERDICT_RULES=<path> (then ./config/verdict_rules.json, then this embedded copy). Shape: {"rules":[{"needle":"substring matched against the lowercased URL","verdict":"challenge|captcha|login|empty|landed|unknown"}]}.
